questions.answer: On campus

questions.answer: There was an option to live in a student village 5 min walk from uni

questions.answer:
You could choose between anything from a studio to an apartment of 8 people.  
I decided to go for an apartment where we were 5 people and one shared kitchen.

questions.answer: That the condition is not very good compared to the standerd in Copenhagen.

questions.answer: I could email a student responsible person but it was a bit hard because of the big time difference.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go around and see the country. Australia is much more than just Sydney. Also, take your time to travel around for a few weeks either before or after the semester ends.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Pretty easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Chat with people in class

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The whole cultural aspect injustice for indigenous people had a bigger impact that I was expecting.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: That I met people from all around the world.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Travel around and see the country - it is worth the money 
Go on daytrips when you have a day off
Bring you active and chill clothes

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Pack light

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: That it has given me a new perspective on a lot of things

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: A ll the work before depature. It can be very stressfull and challenging but don't give up - it is all worth it in the end.
